title: Should You Run 30% Off on Black Friday?

scenes.say: Thirty percent off will pack the room on Black Friday. Will it pay?

props.headline: 30% off fills the room. Does it fill the *till*?

scenes.say: A fifteen dollar lunch with four fifty of food keeps ten fifty. At thirty percent off, it keeps just six.
To match a normal day, a hundred lunches becomes a hundred and seventy-five.
And many deal hunters leave with the next deal.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: A big sale day makes new regulars
props.fact: Deal hunters often follow the next deal, not you

scenes.say: Instead, keep full price and give a free side in December. Two visits keep nineteen fifty, not six.
So: skip the big discount. Give a reason to come back. And count who does.
